policy: Primary vendor documentation and upstream source. Findings establish mechanisms and compatibility questions, not a measured speedup for the Knight EPS model.

sources.title: Intel Core i5-8259U specifications
sources.supports: Q2 2018 mobile CPU, Iris Plus 655, nominal TDP, eDRAM and maximum system-memory bandwidth. Does not predict this scene's frame time.

sources.title: MDN WebGL best practices
sources.supports: Portable VRAM-query limitations, allocation estimation, texture compression, resource lifecycle and upload costs.

sources.title: Three.js r176 ViewportTextureNode
sources.supports: Viewport textures are produced from framebuffer copies, rather than requiring an additional scene render.

sources.title: Three.js r176 PhysicalLightingModel
sources.supports: Refraction samples mipmapped viewport textures; separate front/back texture handling remains relevant.

sources.title: Three.js r176 common Renderer
sources.supports: Opaque then transparent rendering, double-sided handling, initialization and full-size half-float intermediate render-target/sample behavior.

sources.title: Three.js r176 WebGPURenderer
sources.supports: Same-release availability, forceWebGL selection, WebGPU-to-WebGL2 fallback, logarithmic depth and buffer options.

sources.title: Three.js r176 StandardNodeLibrary
sources.supports: Mappings for standard, physical, basic and shadow materials and existing lighting/tone-mapping families. Mapping alone is not visual equivalence.

sources.title: Three.js r176 ShadowNode
sources.supports: Shadow invalidation checks per-light shadow.autoUpdate and shadow.needsUpdate; the current global-only flag policy needs adapter work.

sources.title: Three.js WebGPURenderer migration guidance
sources.supports: Initialization/material migration, fallback and explicit caution that some scenes perform better in legacy WebGLRenderer.

sources.title: Three.js r187 release
sources.supports: Latest official release was verified through GitHub's latest-release API; release published 2026-10-30. No version change is proposed without a specific need.

sources.title: Three.js r187 ViewportTextureNode
sources.supports: Newer viewport/opaque-texture facilities were considered; their presence does not justify an immediate upgrade.

sources.title: Chrome WebGPU overview
sources.supports: API capabilities and browser/platform support context. JavaScript efficiency is not proof of sufficient GPU rendering throughput.

sources.title: Chrome WebGPU troubleshooting
sources.supports: Adapter availability and hardware/browser constraints must be checked; navigator.gpu alone is insufficient evidence of an active hardware backend.

sources.title: Babylon.js glTF transmission helper
sources.supports: The alternative engine also sets up an opaque render target/list with samples and mipmaps, so engine replacement alone is not a demonstrated fix. This source is unpinned master, observed at research time.

sources.title: Babylon.js scene optimization guidance
sources.supports: Differentiates CPU scene evaluation, draws, depth pre-pass and instrumentation; generic advice does not replace model-specific comparison.
